snippet.title: GAME TRAILER - Triste (Indie Roguelike)
snippet.description:
WISHLIST https://store.steampowered.com/app/4057600/Triste/
It’s the first time I’m sharing something from TRISTE, the game I’ve been solo developing. It’s a tactical roguelike full of challenges… here’s the (v1) trailer. I hope you enjoy it!
